correctness.rationale: For odd characteristic, the degree-2 coefficient conic v²+2uw=0 has q+1 projective directions; product B=uw’+wu’+vv’ vanishes on two nonzero isotropic vectors exactly for equal directions. In characteristic two Frobenius leaves u x²+w y² plus three independent higher-tail coordinates and B=uw’+wu’, giving the same q+1 projective classes. Higher tails annihilate all. Hence the join of a universal K_{q³-1} with q+1 copies of K_{(q-1)q³}; graph parameters and q9+q8-q7 ordered product count follow. Independently enumerated all q^9 elements for q=2,3, and all square-zero pair products, confirming 31 and 242 nonzero vertices and 640/24057 ordered annihilating pairs, respectively.
residual_risks: Finite prime-field checks alone do not prove every prime power; projective-conic argument supplies unrestricted proof. Full graph and higher nilpotent strata are not classified.
